title: finding(components,core): the record page H1 (`PageHeaderRenderer`'s own interpolation) and core `formatTitleTemplate` render an expanded-lookup `titleFormat` placeholder differently, so the `record:details` dedupe misses
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with named sites and a measurement. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the execution seat that claims it. The sites are `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx` (`PageHeaderRenderer`'s `interpolate`) and `packages/core/src/utils/record-title.ts` (`formatTitleTemplate`).

Filed by the `domain:ui#4` execution seat (`session_01BP8CMtACxTdLjqR6rhd33C`) from the `os-dev-report` of objectui#10360 (PR objectui#10443, class a). The contract review of that PR confirmed it at source. ⛔ Filed bare, not graded here.

## The defect

Two renderers interpolate the same `titleFormat` with different token rules.
- **The record page H1.** `PageHeaderRenderer` keeps its own `interpolate`: its comment says objectui#9436 moved only this rung's rank. For an object-valued token it returns the empty string (`if (typeof v === 'object') return ''`). `cleanupTitleSeparators` then strips the orphan separator.
- **Core.** `formatTitleTemplate` reduces an embedded object to its display name (`displayNameOfEmbeddedObject`). Core is what the `record:details` dedupe, `getRecordDisplayName`'s `titleFormat` rung and `DetailView.resolveDisplayTitle` use.
- **The effect.** The H1 and the dedupe compare different strings, so a row equal to the H1 is not recognised.

## Measured

The objectui#10360 dev measured this at PR objectui#10443's head `84039bba8`. The fixture was `titleFormat '{account} - {deal_no}'`, with `account` expanded as `{ id: 'a1', name: 'Acme' }` and `deal_no` set to `'Q3-042'`.
- The H1 read `Q3-042`.
- Core rendered `Acme - Q3-042`, a composite, so the dedupe hides nothing.
- The body printed `Deal No Q3-042` again under the H1.

The reviewer also found that the header's token regex accepts neither inner whitespace nor double braces. For those it falls through to the unified resolver, which renders them core's way.

It is reachable on `main` today. It predates objectui#10443, which leaves `containers.tsx` and `record-title.ts` unchanged.

## Grading notes (for triage, not a grade)

- This is the drift ADR-0079-era title work keeps meeting: two interpolators for one declared template. The long-run shape is ONE interpolator (core's), with the header ranking rungs only. objectui#9436 ruled on the rank and deliberately left the interpolation. Whether to converge is a scope question for triage. It may need the objectui#9436 ruling's author.
- Pin: an expanded-lookup placeholder renders the same string in the H1 and in core, and the dedupe then hides the matching row.

## Dedupe

REST page walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui items. The pattern `PageHeaderRenderer` near interpolate / `titleFormat`, `interpolate` near `formatTitleTemplate`, or header near `titleFormat` near lookup / object-valued / diverge ⇒ 1 hit, objectui#9436 (closed: the ruling on which rung wins the record title, which kept this renderer's interpolation; ⛔ not this divergence as a defect). The control `formatTitleTemplate` ⇒ objectui#10434, so the instrument is lit.

Dedupe words: `page header interpolate formatTitleTemplate divergence` · `titleFormat expanded lookup placeholder H1` · `record details dedupe lookup object titleFormat`
